families.title: precise_nested_artifact_construction
families.workflow_analogue: Create an exact project artifact tree from a written specification.
families.context_link: Path creation, quoting, and verification routes differ across bundles while the artifact is portable.
families.not_measured: It does not measure repository history, builds, or persistent services.
families.oracle: The exact required tree and bytes exist and no unrequested artifacts exist.

families.title: recursive_artifact_inventory
families.workflow_analogue: Inspect a heterogeneous directory tree and produce an exact derived inventory.
families.context_link: Traversal, hidden-file handling, separators, and stable ordering expose bundle differences without mandating a command.
families.not_measured: It does not measure semantic code edits or source-control state.
families.oracle: The inventory has the exact portable records and all source bytes remain unchanged.

families.title: quoted_csv_normalization
families.workflow_analogue: Transform messy delimited records while preserving quoted delimiters and encodings.
families.context_link: Available parsing routes, newline conventions, and quoting behavior differ across bundles.
families.not_measured: It does not measure large-scale data performance or statistical correctness.
families.oracle: The normalized table equals the semantic expected records and inputs remain byte-identical.

families.title: recursive_configuration_merge
families.workflow_analogue: Merge layered application configuration under explicit recursive semantics.
families.context_link: Serialization tools and object models vary by environment while JSON semantics remain portable.
families.not_measured: It does not measure live deployment configuration or secret management.
families.oracle: The result matches the recursive semantic merge and both inputs remain unchanged.

families.title: semantic_symbol_rename
families.workflow_analogue: Refactor a symbol across a small repository without rewriting prose lookalikes.
families.context_link: Repository search, parsing, edit, and test routes vary across bundles.
families.not_measured: It does not establish safety on large repositories or compiled languages.
families.oracle: All code references change, protected prose remains exact, and every source file parses.

families.title: cross_file_behavioral_bug_repair
families.workflow_analogue: Diagnose and repair a behavioral bug spanning implementation, caller, and tests while preserving the public contract.
families.context_link: Search, test invocation, failure interpretation, and multi-file editing create authentic context-sensitive routes.
families.not_measured: It does not measure greenfield design quality or production-scale maintenance.
families.oracle: Pinned behavioral tests pass, protected API fixtures remain unchanged, and only allowed source files change.

families.title: semantic_merge_conflict_resolution
families.workflow_analogue: Resolve a real three-way source conflict by preserving compatible intent from both branches.
families.context_link: Git inspection, conflict parsing, editing, testing, and state verification vary across execution bundles.
families.not_measured: It does not measure remote collaboration, rebasing policy, or code-review judgment.
families.oracle: No conflict remains, the index contains the intended semantic merge, tests pass, and no commit is created.

families.title: selective_bad_change_recovery
families.workflow_analogue: Remove one known-bad tracked change while preserving unrelated staged and unstaged work.
families.context_link: Git status/diff interpretation and path-safe recovery require environment-aware command composition.
families.not_measured: It does not measure remote history rewriting or organizational branching policy.
families.oracle: The bad semantic change is absent, all protected work and index states are preserved, and history is unchanged.

families.title: failing_test_and_build_repair
families.workflow_analogue: Use a reproducible failing test/build to locate and repair a packaging or source defect.
families.context_link: Tool discovery, invocation, path behavior, and error recovery differ while the offline project and oracle are fixed.
families.not_measured: It does not measure network package resolution or ecosystem-wide compatibility.
families.oracle: The pinned offline test and build commands pass and protected tests/dependency pins remain unchanged.

families.title: deterministic_local_package_assembly
families.workflow_analogue: Repair metadata and assemble an installable local package with deterministic contents.
families.context_link: Build entrypoints, archives, paths, and smoke-test invocation expose bundle differences without network access.
families.not_measured: It does not measure publishing credentials, registries, or dependency supply-chain security.
families.oracle: The expected archive contents and metadata are exact, a clean local install smoke test passes, and sources stay in scope.

families.title: local_service_health_recovery
families.workflow_analogue: Diagnose a misconfigured local service, start it on an assigned loopback port, verify health, and stop it cleanly.
families.context_link: Process launch, environment variables, ports, logs, and cleanup differ materially across bundles.
families.not_measured: It does not measure distributed systems, privileged services, or external networking.
families.oracle: The health and behavior probes pass during execution, the corrected config persists, and no child process remains.

families.title: bounded_batch_job_execution
families.workflow_analogue: Configure and run a local batch job with scoped environment, captured diagnostics, exact output, and cleanup.
families.context_link: Environment scoping, quoting, subprocess behavior, encoding, and exit evidence vary across bundles.
families.not_measured: It does not measure cloud schedulers, GPUs, or long-running production jobs.
families.oracle: The exact output and diagnostic record exist, secrets are absent, inputs are unchanged, and no process or temp artifact remains.
